100421.title: Front wheel assembly overview
guidance: Check that 1 EA LL Hub (Product Number HU-6280) is complete and turns freely. Its supplied nested BOM identifies 1 EA LL Shell (Product Number SH-4562) and 1 EA LL Spindle/Axle (Product Number SD-2342); internal assembly details are not supplied.
Inspect 1 EA LL Mountain Rim (Product Number RM-M464), 36 EA Spokes (Product Number SK-9283), and 36 EA LL Nipple (Product Number NI-4127) for visible damage and count them before assembly.

Position the hub and rim in an assumed wheel-building jig; connect the spokes and nipples using an appropriate pattern and product guidance. The component relationships are shown in illustration 100421.
Inspect and fit 1 EA Mountain Tire Tube (Product Number TT-M928) and 1 EA LL Mountain Tire (Product Number TI-M267) to the assembled wheel using appropriate product guidance; avoid pinching the tube.
Attach 2 EA Reflector (Product Number RF-9198) using their supplied fitting method and check that they are secure.
